result.reason: The added vendor indemnity substantially reaches the preferred vendor-side position by covering third-party IP claims, breach of law, Vendor-caused data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice, defense control, settlement consent, and cooperation procedures. However, the Client indemnity remains materially broader than permitted: it covers any breach of the Agreement, conduct causing TrueLink defaults, broad website-related claims, and product or service injury, rather than being limited to Client-provided content and Client's breach of law. The drafting also unnecessarily creates overlapping Vendor indemnities in Sections b and c instead of consolidating them, and the procedures apply only to the new indemnity. Unrelated commercial intent is otherwise preserved.
